title: Slower Evia walkthrough and accurate closing avatar
details: Show me around now holds each explanation for longer so the learner has time to read and follow what Evia is showing
Evia's movement between areas is slower and more deliberate while keeping the same curved floating motion
Evidence-source colours, guided audio, assessor exchange, Learn and Test demonstrations all remain unchanged
The final Evia now reuses the same face construction as the moving walkthrough avatar, with the correct larger eye size and spacing
No demo limits, learner evidence behaviour, targets or QR activation behaviour are changed
summary: Evia v219 slows the animated product tour to a more comfortable pace and makes the closing Evia match the real avatar exactly.
changes: Extended scene holds and speech-bubble reading time
Slowed short and long Evia travel animations
Staggered Mock Practical, Maths and English explanations
Rebuilt the closing Evia from the same face, eye and expression components used by the moving guide
Created a fresh v219 offline cache
